children: America’s Car-Mart reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results with total revenue of $145.8 million and a net loss attributable to common shareholders of $68.99 million. The company recorded an adjusted loss per share of $6.65 and reported total gross profit per retail unit of $8,015. Management cited constrained inventory and capital as primary drivers of the period's performance.
Total revenue: $145.8 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026.
Sales (vehicle sales): $89.902 million; interest income: $55.849 million.
Gross profit margin (total gross profit percentage): 21.8%; total gross profit per retail unit sold: $8,015.
Net loss attributable to common shareholders: $68.99 million (net loss: $68.98 million).
Adjusted loss per share (non-GAAP): $(6.65) per diluted share; GAAP diluted loss per share: $(8.28).
Retail units sold declined 81.9% to 2,450 units as the company intentionally constrained vehicle purchases to preserve liquidity.
Ending inventory fell to $35.2 million (down 68.7% year-over-year) after deliberate inventory drawdown during the quarter.
Company wholesaled substantially all repossessed vehicles beginning in late May to accelerate cash conversion, increasing third-party wholesale sales to $21.0 million.
Dealership footprint rationalization completed in prior period reduced locations from 154 to 94, and the company implemented centralized collections across consolidated dealerships.
Principal balance of finance receivables declined 21.4% year-over-year to $1,190.95 million; accounts over 30 days past due were 4.6% at quarter end.
